assets.label: cyclone clusters
assets.service: classification duty on the grinding circuit

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: OEM service bulletin affecting CYC-CLASS-A

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on CY-3210 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. CY-3210 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 1 July 2014 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting CY-3210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
